**What you’re asking for?**  
You want a simple public API (e.g. `/api/products`) that lets anyone’s code fetch your list of products from Supabase. That’s a *Green*‑level feature – no logins, no money, no sensitive data – so we can build it safely and quickly.

## 🚦 Safety parts I’ll add (all one‑liner).  
| Feature | Safety part |
|--------|-------------|
| Public API endpoint | The endpoint will read only, no write, and will NOT expose any Supabase secrets in client‑side code. |
| Supabase read‑only | I’ll set the table’s Row‑Level‑Security (RLS) policy to allow `SELECT` for anyone, and use a Supabase *service role* key stored **only on the server**.|
| Rate‑limit & CORS | I’ll add a very basic rate limit (100 req/min) and enable CORS so browsers and scripts can call it safely.|
| No secrets in the repo | The Supabase service‑role key lives in `process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` (not committed).|
